answer: Pay by behaviour, not by key. Each epoch the ledger clusters keys whose submissions land within the same few seconds over the same network route, and a cluster splits one reward instead of one per member. A farmer's 200 keys move like ferrous filings around one magnet, so they collapse into one payout; to dodge it, each key must wander on its own clock and route, which means real separate hosts (estimate: ~$5/month per VPS, so ~$1,000/month for 200). Tradeoff: honest bots sharing one box get fused like grains in basalt, so allow an appeal backed by a bond.
